position_space: Authored body mesh rest positions, Blender metres; position_gltf=(x,z,-y).
weights_use: Exact original Human R11 bone names; resolve through the imported named Skin bind.

explicit_source_boundary_weight_outliers.reason: Original vertex 741 is a source boundary-seam thumb-weight outlier: 99.924% Thumb1 versus 28–30% on neighbors640/742. It stretches the existing tiny seam under thumb opposition.
explicit_source_boundary_weight_outliers.rule: Only vertex741; reuse source742 proportions among RightHand* groups; preserve all original741 non-hand influences exactly; no geometry edits.

palm_extension.method: Unpatched source central palm within explicit Hand-rest-space bounds receives Hand/proximal weights. Thumb-side web uses a continuous20–45mm lateral smoothstep and85–110mm distal taper; other families use an18–34mm chain-distance envelope. Preserve originalnon-hand mass exactly.

preserved: Positions, topology, UVs, material assignments, normals, 229 shape-key blocks and skeleton rest data.
method: Own-finger nearest rest-chain assignment; smooth adjacent-phalanx weights and palm/proximal transition. Existing non-hand influence mass retained, with only normalization rounding. Additional central-palm stabilization outside the original finger-chain eligibility region.
